description: security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm is extended directly rather than through config:best-practices, whose helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests contradicts the convention that actions are pinned to exact release tags. local>kanso-labs/.github:renovate-config is the organization's shared preset, listed last because a later preset wins a conflict with an earlier one.

packageRules.description: react and react-dom release together and must match, and their types follow them.
